summary: Maintain agent roster cards incrementally through live presentation and wake only for changed inputs or evidence deadlines

replay.detail: Existing claims and projections remain authoritative; no replay is required.

rules.detail: The roster owner no longer periodically reevaluates every second or delays updates with refresh pacing. Commits, explicit demand, delivery presence and relayed freshness wake its demand-gated owner. Clock wakes occur at the earliest queue, restart, freshness, launch, heartbeat or subagent eligibility boundary. Unchanged cards retain their presentation, fault and reference enrichment. An expired restart marker restores the underlying state's delivery and launch dependencies as well as its displayed state.

compatibility.detail: Live diagnostic ages in published cards are snapshots updated with semantic evidence changes rather than periodic age ticks. Publication valid-until now names an actual evidence deadline and may be absent. The performance endpoint adds agent_roster_work (builds, card_rebuilds, largest_fold, presentations, fault_enrichments, ref_enrichments), agent_roster_presentation_work.card_rebuilds, attention_work and summary_work. Work counters are process-lifetime totals; largest_fold is the largest individual source-card fold.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout; existing readers and publication envelopes remain supported.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores the previous maintenance behavior without durable-state changes.
